heading: Engineering for Reliability and Scale
subheading: Backend systems for payments, lending, and operational resilience.
bio: For more than 6 years, I have been building backend platforms that handle real transactional load across payments, transfers, lending, onboarding, and internal operational tooling, including systems serving 4M+ API requests per day.

My strongest work sits at the intersection of architecture and delivery: designing Spring Boot microservices, shaping event-driven flows with Kafka and SQS, tuning PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Elasticsearch, and shipping systems that are secure, observable, and production-ready.

I bring a security-first and team-first mindset to delivery, combining Spring Security, OAuth2, JWT, and RBAC patterns with strong code reviews, TDD, and mentorship so teams can scale quality alongside throughput.

highlights.title: API-First Architecture
highlights.description: I design services around clean contracts, secure integrations, and maintainable domain boundaries so teams can ship faster with fewer surprises.

highlights.title: Event-Driven Thinking
highlights.description: From asynchronous notifications to search and workflow orchestration, I use messaging patterns that improve responsiveness without sacrificing clarity or reliability.

highlights.title: Delivery and Mentorship
highlights.description: I value pragmatic execution, strong code reviews, and sharing context so teams can improve throughput without lowering engineering standards.
